tools.name: filter_home_service_pros
tools.description: Refines a prior home-service search using request-form answers. There is no saved search, so pass categoryID + zipCode + the full accumulated answer set (from search_home_service_pros) on each call.

inputSchema.title: filter_home_service_pros input
inputSchema.description: Refines a pro search using request-form answers. There is no saved search, so pass categoryID + zipCode + the requestForm (its requestFormID plus the full accumulated answer set) on each call.

zipCode.description: US ZIP code to center the search (5 digits).

categoryID.description: The Thumbtack Category ID to fetch businesses for. Obtain from search_home_service_pros.

requestForm.description: Request form details supplied by the agent. There is no saved search: resubmit the requestFormID plus the full accumulated set of answers each time.

requestFormID.description: The Request Form ID for this category, from search_home_service_pros.

requestFormAnswers.description: The full accumulated set of answers to request-form questions.

tools.name: get_category_recommendations
tools.description: Returns popular or trending home-service categories for a US ZIP code.

inputSchema.title: get_category_recommendations input
inputSchema.description: Returns popular or trending home-service categories by ZIP code. zipCode is optional; it is resolved from the current page or browser location when omitted. limit: default 20, range 1-30.

zipCode.description: US ZIP code to center the search (5 digits). Optional; resolved from the current page or browser location when omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories to return (default 20, range 1-30). Values above 30 are clamped to 30.

tools.name: get_reviews_for_pros
tools.description: Returns detailed customer reviews for specific Thumbtack businesses, grouped by business and sorted by the requested order (relevance, rating, or recency).

inputSchema.title: get_reviews_for_pros input
inputSchema.description: Fetches detailed reviews for specific business IDs. limit: default 5, max 20 (values above 20 are clamped). When sortBy is 'most_relevant', at least one of categoryID or searchQuery is required.

businessIDs.description: Business identifiers to get reviews for (as strings).

sortBy.description: Sort order for the fetched reviews.

categoryID.description: The Thumbtack categoryID (required with searchQuery when using most_relevant sort).

searchQuery.description: The search query string (required with categoryID when using most_relevant sort).

limit.description: Number of reviews per business to return (default 5, max 20). Values above 20 are clamped to 20.

tools.name: search_home_service_pros
tools.description: Searches Thumbtack home-service pros from a free-text query and ZIP code, returning matching businesses, the best-matching category, and a request form to refine the results.

inputSchema.title: search_home_service_pros input
inputSchema.description: Initiates a search from a free-text user query and optional zip. zipCode is optional; it is resolved from the current page or browser location when the agent omits it.

userQuery.description: The complete user query/prompt describing the home service they need (e.g., 'I need a house cleaner', 'plumber for kitchen sink repair').

zipCode.description: US ZIP code to center the search (5 digits). Optional; resolved from the current page or browser location when omitted.
